name: slime-split
comment: WP-2.3b. Stone platform y = 60 over -10..10 with a three-high wall (a size-4 slime clears a one-high rim); no player. A slime (id 0; the spawn op's seeded constructor draws give size 4 at this seed) jumps for 400 ticks: EntitySlime.updatePlayerActionState's jump timer (rand.nextInt(20) + 10 per jump, strafe draw, sound draws above size 1), the landing squish and particle draws (EntitySlime.onUpdate). t=400: attack, no attacker, damage 16 = its health (the split needs health exactly 0); 20 ticks later EntitySlime.setEntityDead splits it into four size-2 slimes (ids 1-4, yaw from the parent's rand). Their constructors draw slimeJumpDelay from the oracle's still unseeded Random (census section 3; the join hook does not redraw it), so they are killed at t=421 (damage 4 = health) before their first ground tick runs the timer; at t=441 they split into sixteen size-1 slimes (ids 5-20), killed at t=442 (damage 1): no split, slimeball drops (EntitySlime.getDropItemId) from rand.nextInt(3). rng_state and entity_state every tick.
